name: usagetrim
description: Keep the signal. Cut the noise. Fold verbose tool output and recover originals by reference — local MCP for Claude Desktop.
long_description: UsageTrim exposes compact code navigation, command runners, and recoverable cache tools so Claude Desktop does not pull raw pytest, docker, or git dumps into context. No cloud relay. Local estimates only — not billing claims.

tools.name: usagetrim_context
tools.description: Save/read bounded task milestones across session turns.

tools.name: usagetrim_code
tools.description: Search local syntax index (symbols, occurrences, outline, callers, references, patterns) or ranked repo map.

tools.name: usagetrim_edit_symbol
tools.description: Atomic symbol replacement in source file guarded by file hash.

tools.name: usagetrim_exec
tools.description: Run noninteractive shell command with output compaction.

tools.name: usagetrim_read
tools.description: Targeted file read by skeleton outline, symbol, or line range with bounded output.

tools.name: usagetrim_retrieve
tools.description: Recover full original output from SQLite cache by ref_id.

tools.name: usagetrim_diff
tools.description: Compact git diff folding lockfiles and build artifacts.

tools.name: usagetrim_clip
tools.description: Compact noisy text, logs, diffs, or stack traces before pasting into chat.

tools.name: usagetrim_optimize
tools.description: Autonomous prompt, code block, log, and table context optimizer.
